name: Requirement Violation: Token Expiration Check Omitted
provenance: Reproduced from real auth session bug pattern (PR #4 audit)
raw_diff:
diff --git a/src/auth/service.py b/src/auth/service.py
--- a/src/auth/service.py
+++ b/src/auth/service.py
@@ -5,3 +5,6 @@
     def authenticate(self, token_str: str) -> bool:
         token = verify_signature(token_str)
+        if not token:
+            return False

name: Security Defect: Non-Constant-Time Secret Comparison
provenance: CWE-208 timing attack vulnerability pattern in webhook verification

changed_files.src/crypto/signatures.py:
import hmac
import hashlib

def verify_webhook_signature(payload: bytes, secret: str, expected_sig: str) -> bool:
    computed = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    # Security Bug: == is susceptible to timing side-channel attacks
    return computed == expected_sig

raw_diff:
diff --git a/src/crypto/signatures.py b/src/crypto/signatures.py
--- a/src/crypto/signatures.py
+++ b/src/crypto/signatures.py
@@ -3,2 +3,5 @@
 def verify_webhook_signature(payload: bytes, secret: str, expected_sig: str) -> bool:
+    computed = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+    return computed == expected_sig

requirements.text: Cryptographic signature validation must use constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.

expected_issues.label: issue
expected_issues.rationale: computed == expected_sig is vulnerable to timing attacks; use hmac.compare_digest.

ground_truth.rationale: Direct violation of constant-time requirement REQ-SEC-01.
